title: The receive window still works, with the new notice words
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a special-order part ordered and not yet received.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Receive the special-order part at a new cost.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The receive window works as today and its notice reads "Updating the cost also updates the sell price."
  • It no longer adds "to keep the margin".
  • The part is received at the new cost.
